# cutting mat designer

> A high-performance parametric vector studio for designing custom self-healing craft and drafting cutting mats with high-precision grid mathematics, draggable stickers, multi-anchor protractors, and SVG/PDF/PNG exports.

## Core Documentation

- [CONTEXT.md](https://github.com/nischalmudennavar/cutting-mat-designer/blob/main/CONTEXT.md): High-density AI agent operating manual, mathematical domain invariants, and coordinate scaling formulas.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/nischalmudennavar/cutting-mat-designer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Developer setup, architecture walkthrough, coding standards, and PR workflows.
- [README.md](https://github.com/nischalmudennavar/cutting-mat-designer/blob/main/README.md): Project overview, feature tour, and quickstart commands.

## Architecture & Mathematical Invariants

- **96 DPI Coordinate Scale**: Calculates physical dimensions into SVG user units: Inches (`* 96`), Metric cm (`* 96 / 2.54`), Fine mm (`* 96 / 25.4`), Pixels (`1.0`).
- **Symmetric Integer Grid Gap Elimination**: Computes whole cell integer counts ($N_x, N_y$) and derives balanced symmetrical margins ($B_x, B_y$) to guarantee zero fractional border edge gaps.
- **Protractor Clamping**: Enforces origin-based geometric radius limits ($R_{max}$) to prevent arcs and ray lines from spilling outside mat borders.
- **Unified Pointer Engine**: Implements pointer capture (`setPointerCapture`) and state machine partitioning (`idle`, `panning`, `dragging-sticker`) to prevent drag/pan interference.
- **Compound SVG GPU Tessellation**: Concatenates major grids, subdivisions, ticks, and protractor guidelines into 5 compound `<path>` nodes instead of thousands of discrete DOM elements.

## Astryx Component Primitives (`src/components/ui/`)

- `Modal.tsx`: Dark glassmorphic dialog with backdrop blur, escape key, and backdrop dismiss.
- `Dropdown.tsx`: Custom floating glass popover with checkmarks and outside click dismissal.
- `Switch.tsx`: Animated sliding thumb toggle switch.
- `ColorPicker.tsx`: Color swatch preview trigger with hex value badge.
- `NumberInput.tsx`: Stepper numeric input with `+` / `-` increment buttons.
- `SegmentedControl.tsx`: Active pill tab selector for units and border radius modes.
- `Slider.tsx`: Custom range slider with dynamic live value readout.
- `Button.tsx`: Atomic button supporting primary, secondary, outline, ghost, icon, and danger variants.
- `Accordion.tsx`: Collapsible accordion card with chevron state.

## Operational Commands

- `npm run dev`: Starts local development server with Turbopack.
- `npm run build`: Compiles production build with strict TypeScript type checking.
- `npm run start`: Launches production server.
- `npm run lint`: Runs ESLint checks.
